label: late-episode dip: D1 after a1->S2 (rare) and after reward; belief-signed at GO/D2
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 6.0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 6.0) ;; (phase == GO) * table(prev_action, {1: 1, 2: -1}) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 6.0) ;; (phase != D1) * belief_lo * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 6.0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 6.0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * (belief < 0.5) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 6.0)
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 13 sits near 1.0 and only drops (to ~0.66) in the last ~10 trials of an episode; timing (phase x decile) explains R^2 0.54. Beyond timing, all magnitude effects scale with closeness to the episode end (exp((ep_trial-99)/6)). At D1 the gate dips most after the previous trial was a1 reaching S2 (rare, either reward), stays higher after reaching S1, and dips after a reward, with an extra dip after a rewarded S2 visit when the ideal observer already believes S2 is good. At GO it is lower after a previous a1 choice than a2; at GO/D2 it is lower when belief favours S1 (belief_lo, graded). Six observed-only terms give dev R^2 beyond timing 0.26 (vs 'all' additive ceiling 0.13 and 'all observed' 0.11, which lack the late-time interaction). The largest residual dips (single-step drops to ~0.67-0.75 at D1 near t96-98) are episode-specific and not captured; the trial-before reward and |belief| added little. No model-output terms were used, so the loss relative to the earlier value/policy explanation could not be scored here; the profile's policy-decile reference (0.05) vs belief-decile (0.03) suggests the loss is small.
